description: Curated diff -> perf scenario map. Read by the perf-gatekeeper skill (PR-time targeted perf check), by the orchestrator's slice-boundary perf auto-run (process-rules.md § Perf slice-boundary auto-run) and by the end-of-session orphan-scenario sweep (a scenario named here is curated, never an orphan). Matching: a touched repo-relative path matches a rule when Python fnmatch.fnmatchcase(path, glob) holds for any of the rule's globs (`*` also crosses `/`). The union of every matched rule's scenarios runs once each. A touched first-party source path that matches no rule runs `fallback` and is reported as a map gap. A rule with alsoRunTouchedScenario adds every scenario the diff adds or edits (its registered Name()). The CI gate (.github/workflows/perf-pr-fast.yml) does not read this file: it runs the fixed set in scripts/dev/perf-pr-fast-set.json. Every scenario named here must be registered in Source/Core/src/Commands/Scenarios/SmatchetScenarioRegistry.cpp.
